basic_info.description: Experience Noe Valley living at its finest in this thoughtfully reimagined 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath residence spanning four levels, where timeless San Francisco architecture meets modern luxury. The chef's kitchen showcases Italian marble accents, lacquered cabinetry, wide-plank european oak flooring, and Gaggenau + Thermador appliances. A generous lower level offers a spacious family retreat, while artist Caroline Lizarraga helped transform the glass and steel architectural stairwell into a design centerpiece. Fresh finishes and smart home upgrades including NEST climate control with A/C on all four levels enhance comfort and style throughout. Outdoors, a professionally designed backyard oasis by Cobble & Forge features a heated pergola dining area, living wall, raised beds, playful climbing structure, and upgraded lighting and irrigation. A luxury outdoor kitchen with grill & sink is durable, modern, & made for entertaining. Sustainability defines the home, with a 22-panel SunPower solar array, Tesla Powerwall, high-efficiency heat pump, LED lighting. Set between Dolores Heights and Noe Valley's sunny microclimates just steps from 24th Street cafes, shops, and playgrounds, this is a rare opportunity to own a home that blends elegance, efficiency, & community.
